dct_title_s: The Rand-McNally new commercial atlas map of Minnesota
dct_alternative_sm: The Rand-McNally new commercial atlas map of Minnesota
dct_description_sm: Cartographic Details: Scale 1:1,013,760 ; Statute miles, 16 = 1 in. (W 97°15'--W 89°30'/N 49°23'--N 43°30'). Red overprinting shows railroads. Insets: N.E. corner of Minnesota showing Cook Co. -- Minneapolis, St. Paul and vicinity. Indexed.
